title: Astro Portal spoken reading manifest
description:
`read-aloud/<voiceVersion>/<locale>/manifest.json` of the static-data package: one language of the optional `read-aloud` offline-pack component (« Lecture à voix haute »), written by the generator (READ-ALOUD-GEN-01) once every unit file of the language is deposited under `read-aloud/<voiceVersion>/<locale>/u/<id>.m4a`, and served by the portal at `/v1/offline-pack/read-aloud/{locale}/{voiceVersion}/manifest.json`. The three levels nest by construction: every fiche names the smallest level it belongs to; Essentiel is the fiches of level `essential`, Étendu those of `essential` and `extended`, Complet all of them, in the order of `fiches` (the reading order). A unit is one paragraph spoken once: its `id` is the first 16 bytes, in hexadecimal, of `sha256(normalisedText + "
" + locale + "
" + voice + "
" + voiceVersion)` (the app computes the same id from the text it would read); `bytes` and `sha256` are those of the `.m4a` file; `cues` are the start of each sentence in the file, in milliseconds (the first is 0, never decreasing). A paragraph that two fiches share is one unit, listed in both with the same `bytes` and `sha256`. The folder names are `voiceVersion` and `locale` themselves; a manifest that contradicts its folder is ignored.

voiceVersion.description: Names the voice and the generation (`azure-hd-2026-11`); a new one changes every id of the language, so versions never mix.

voice.description: The provider's name of the voice (`fr-FR-Vivienne:DragonHDLatestNeural`).

source.description: Shown to the person: « Voix de synthèse neuronale HD ».

license.description: What the provider's terms allow for the redistribution of the generated audio.

format.description: How the units are encoded (HE-AAC 32 kbit/s mono in an `.m4a` per the study).

id.description: The page read: a target's slug (`m31`), or the name of a guide page (`guided-evening-intro`). Unique in the manifest.

units.description: The paragraphs of the page, in reading order.
